# TapTile — Pakistan's 1st Digital Receipt Network

> TapTile is a zero-POS-change hardware and software network that intercepts receipt data at the point of sale, instantly delivering digital receipts to customers via NFC tap or QR code in under two seconds — eliminating thermal paper roll costs by 85% and automating FBR (Federal Board of Revenue) fiscal compliance for Pakistani retailers.

## What TapTile Does

TapTile is a fintech infrastructure company based in Pakistan that provides:

- **Digital Receipt Delivery:** Customers receive itemized receipts on their smartphone via NFC tap or QR scan at checkout — no app download required.
- **Zero POS Modification:** A plug-and-play hardware device connects to your counter setup, enabling digital receipts without modifying your billing software.
- **FBR Fiscalization Automation:** The platform auto-generates and transmits fiscal invoice records to FBR Tier-1 servers for regulatory compliance.
- **Paper Cost Elimination:** Reduces thermal paper roll procurement expenses by up to 85%.
- **Offline Resilience:** Operates fully offline, ensuring continuous checkout operations with automatic cloud sync upon reconnection.

## Technical Overview

- Universal printer & POS compatibility without software modifications
- NFC delivery speed: Under 2 seconds from tap to receipt
- QR code generation: High-density, universal mobile browser support
- Backend: Cloud-synced infrastructure with offline-first counter resilience
- Compliance: Automated FBR Tier-1 invoice transmission
